title: Base model and minimum effort
text: The shipped scheme has 5 INTERN low rows, 7 JUNIOR rows (Grok/Terra/Sonnet high; Opus/Sol/Fable/Astra low), 4 SENIOR medium rows (Opus/Sol/Fable/Astra), and 2 PRINCIPAL xhigh rows (Fable/Astra). Speed does not change membership. Published catalog efforts constrain writes.
evidence: Production QA run 45473 / artifact 32323 and universe.levels.get, 2026-10-13.
